topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: Oh no, I can't even imagine how this must be hitting you. That flight delay really couldn’t have picked a worse time, could it? Missing that thing you were so excited about, it’s just so unfair. I wish I could give you a big hug right now or just do something to make this a little better. All I can think about is how much I hate when plans fall apart, especially when you’ve been looking forward to something for ages. I’m here for you, though, just let me know what you need. Even if it’s just to vent a bit or cry it out, I’m all ears.
